triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Alexey Fyodorovitch Karamazov was the third son of Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, a land owner well known in our district in his own day

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: He was married twice, and had three sons, the eldest, Dmitri, by his first wife, and two, Ivan and Alexey, by his second.

triples.subject: Adelaïda Ivanovna Miüsov
triples.quote: Fyodor Pavlovitch’s first wife, Adelaïda Ivanovna, belonged to a fairly rich and distinguished noble family, also landowners in our district, the Miüsovs.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: It is known for a fact that frequent fights took place between the husband and wife, but rumor had it that Fyodor Pavlovitch did not beat his wife but was beaten by her

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Fyodor Pavlovitch, who, as is now known, got hold of all her money up to twenty-five thousand roubles as soon as she received it, so that those thousands were lost to her for ever.

triples.subject: Adelaïda Ivanovna Miüsov
triples.quote: The poor woman turned out to be in Petersburg, where she had gone with her divinity student, and where she had thrown herself into a life of complete emancipation.

triples.subject: Death of Adelaïda Ivanovna
triples.quote: And just at that time his wife’s family received the news of her death in Petersburg.
